violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: PORTIONED RICE AT 113, 128F, PORTIONED MASHED POTATOES AT 111-121F, CHICKEN TENDERS AT 121-128F IN HOT HOLDING CENTER LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SLICED TOMATOES AT 44F, CUT LETTUCE AT 44F, SHREDDED CHEESE AT 49F, MUSHROOM GRAVY AT 44F, RAW BEEF PATTIES AT 44F AND RAW CHICKEN TENDERS AT 44FF IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR; PASTA AT 44F IN TRUE 1 DOOR PREP (FRYERS).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD SLICED TOMATOES, CUT LETTUCE, SHREDDED CHEESE AND PASTA. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER RAW BEEF PATTIES AND CHICKEN TENDERS TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F. OTHER TCS FOODS WERE TRANSFERRED TO TRUE 1 DOOR UPRIGHT UNIT AND RANDELL 2 DOOR PREP UNIT.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WALK IN REFRIGERATOR AT 46-54F DURING INSPECTION. EHS OBSERVED UNIT TEMPERATURE OF 35F RECORDED AT 2:47PM.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. TCS FOODS TEMPED ABOVE 41F FOR HELD FOR MORE THAN 4 HOURS WERE DISCARDED. OTHER TCS FOODS WERE TRANSFERRED TO OTHER REFRIGERATION UNITS. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REQUEST SERVICE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: WHITE RICE AT 94F AND ADOBE RICE 129F IN WARMERS; GRAVY AT 121F IN KETTLE; SPAGHETTI SAUCE AT 110F (STEAM TABLE).

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: RAW CHICKEN NUGGETS 61F, RAW CHICKEN TENDERS 51F IN RANDALL 2 DOOR PREP TOP (BREADING STATION)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: PRECOOKED NOODLES STORED IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR FOR 18 DAYS AFTER REMOVAL FROM FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE PRODUCT ASSESSMENT WHICH INDICATES NOODLES ARE NON TCS AND CAN BE HELD AT 41F FOR MORE THAN 7 DAYS. PIC AGREED TO HOLD NOODLES FOR 7 DAYS UNTIL PRODUCT ASSESSMENT HAS BEEN PROVIDED.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: TRUE 1 DR PREP TOP (GRILL STATION).
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PLEASE PROVIDE UNIT THERMOMETER. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.
